title: Bread from Heaven
reflectionQuestion: God sent fresh bread every single morning, just enough for that day. I wonder what good thing you could thank God for giving you today?
kidSafetyNotes: Claims OPEN registry anchor manna (Moses & Exodus). Toward-100. The 'What is it?' naming (manna) is the kid-delight beat. WATCH-ITEM: 'gather just enough for today' framed as God providing DAY BY DAY / do-not-worry-about-tomorrow -- gentle, NOT an anti-hoarding scold. The grumbling kept light + God 'not angry' (god-with-not-cause spirit). Sky-bread wonder is the replay hook (waking to fresh frost-flakes each morning). Soft close ('time'). VOICE_DEBORAH_WISE (warm, wise; provision/gratitude register).

scriptureKeyVerse.text: When the children of Israel saw it, they said to one another, “What is it?” For they didn’t know what it was. Moses said to them, “It is the bread which Yahweh has given you to eat.
